blocks.text: if I knew ... / I wish I knew ... — hozirgi xayoliy holat

38-darsda ko'rdik: **If** + Past Simple — hozirgi yoki kelasi xayoliy holat (→ 38-dars). Xuddi shu o'tgan zamon shakli **wish** dan keyin ham ishlatiladi: I **wish** I **knew** — **Qani endi bilsam** (lekin bilmayman). Ikkalasining mantiqi bir: o'tgan zamon shakli **haqiqatdan uzoqlikni** bildiradi. O'zbekchada: «**bilganimda edi**», «**qani endi bilsam**», «**afsuski, bilmayman**». Har bir xayoliy gap ortida teskari haqiqat turadi — buni doim tekshirib ko'ring.

rows: If I **knew** his number, I'd call him.
If we **lived** by the sea, we'd swim every day.
If it **wasn't raining**, we'd go out.
If I **could** drive, I'd buy a car.

items.text: If I **knew** the answer, I**'d tell** you, honestly.
I **wish** I **knew** why my laptop keeps switching itself off.
items.translation: **Qani endi** noutbukim nega o'z-o'zidan o'chib qolayotganini **bilsam**.

blocks.text: **I wish** + **Past Simple** (yoki Past Continuous) — hozirgi holatdan norozilik yoki afsus: I **wish** I **had** more time — **Qani endi** vaqtim ko'proq **bo'lsa** (vaqtim kam). Zamon xuddi if dagidek bir qadam orqaga suriladi: have → **had**, live → **lived**, is raining → **was raining**, can → **could**. O'zbekchada «**qani endi ...sa**», «**...sa edi**», ba'zan «**afsuski ...**». wish faqat I bilan emas: She **wishes** she **lived** in London, Don't you **wish** you **had** more free time?

items.text: Dilnoza **wishes** her office **had** windows — she never sees the sun at work.
items.translation: Dilnoza **qani endi** ofisimda deraza **bo'lsa**, deydi — ishda quyoshni umuman ko'rmaydi.

items.text: I **wish** my neighbour **wasn't drilling** the wall at seven in the morning.
items.translation: **Qani endi** qo'shnim ertalab soat yettida devorni **teshmayotgan bo'lsa**.

blocks.text: were: If I were you, I wish it were ...

if va wish dan keyin **be** fe'li barcha shaxslarda **were** bo'lishi mumkin: If I **were** you, If she **were** here, I wish it **were** Friday. Og'zaki nutqda I / he / she / it bilan **was** ham keng ishlatiladi (If I **was** rich ...), lekin yozma va rasmiy matnda **were** yaxshiroq. **If I were you, I'd ...** — maslahat berishning turg'un qolipi: «**Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam**, ...»; bu iborada odatda faqat **were**.

items.text: If I **were** you, I**'d** ask for a second opinion before the operation.
items.translation: **Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam**, operatsiyadan oldin boshqa shifokorning ham fikrini **so'rardim**.

items.text: Bekzod **wishes** his brother **were** here to help him with the business.
items.translation: Bekzod **qani endi** akam shu yerda **bo'lsa**-yu, biznesimga yordam bersa, deydi.

blocks.text: Qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat haqida xayol qilganda **could** ishlatiladi: If I **could** speak Chinese, I'd work in Shanghai — Xitoycha **gapira olganimda**, Shanxayda ishlardim. I **wish** I **could** come — **Qani endi kela olsam** (lekin kela olmayman). Natija qismida ham **could** bo'lishi mumkin: If I had a car, I **could** visit you more often — ... tez-tez **kela olardim**.

items.text: I **wish** I **could** sleep on planes — long flights are torture for me.
items.translation: **Qani endi** samolyotda **uxlay olsam** — uzoq parvozlar men uchun azob.

items.text: If Kate **could** cook, she **wouldn't** spend so much on takeaways.
items.translation: Keyt ovqat **pishira olganida**, tayyor ovqatga bunchalik ko'p pul **sarflamasdi**.

blocks.text: if va wish dan keyin would yo'q

Hozirgi xayoliy holat uchun if-qismda ham, wish dan keyin ham **would** ishlatilmaydi: «If I would know» emas — If I **knew**; «I wish I would have a car» emas — I wish I **had** a car. O'zingiz haqingizda «I wish I would ...» deyilmaydi — **I wish I could** ... deng. **I wish** + boshqa kishi + **would** esa boshqa ma'no: norozilik va o'zgarish istagi (I wish you **would** listen!) — bu 41-darsda (→ 41-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I wish I have more money» → I wish I **had** more money (wish dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi); «I wish I would know» → I wish I **knew**; «If I would be you» → If I **were** you; «I wish I can come» → I wish I **could** come; «I wish you are here» → I wish you **were** here; «I wish» ni kelajak uchun tilak ma'nosida ishlatish: «I wish you pass the exam» → I **hope** you pass the exam (→ 41-dars).

wish gapini to'g'ri tuzish uchun avval **haqiqatni** ayting, keyin uni teskarisiga aylantirib, zamonni bir qadam orqaga suring: I **don't have** a garden → I wish I **had** a garden. I **can't** come → I wish I **could** come. It **is** cold → I wish it **wasn't** (weren't) cold.

rows: I wish I **lived** in the centre.

examples.title: **If** I **knew** ..., I**'d** ...: the present, imagined
examples.description: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l — hozirgi holat haqida xayol: haqiqatda bunday emas. if-qism gapning boshida ham, oxirida ham.

sentences.text: If I **knew** Emma's address, I**'d send** her a postcard from Khiva.
sentences.translation: Emmaning manzilini **bilganimda**, unga Xivadan otkritka **yuborardim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **would help** us if she **had** more time, but she's working two jobs.
sentences.translation: Vaqti ko'proq **bo'lganida**, Sara bizga **yordam berardi**, lekin u ikki joyda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: If my brother **lived** nearer, we**'d see** each other every weekend.
sentences.translation: Akam yaqinroqda **yashaganida**, har dam olish kuni **ko'rishardik**.

sentences.text: I**'d buy** an electric car if there **were** more charging stations in the city.
sentences.translation: Shaharda quvvatlash shoxobchalari ko'proq **bo'lganida**, elektromobil **sotib olardim**.

sentences.text: This flat **would be** perfect if it **had** a balcony.
sentences.translation: Bu kvartiraning balkoni **bo'lganida**, u **mukammal bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **wouldn't be** so tired all the time if he **went** to bed earlier.
sentences.translation: Ertaroq **yotganida**, Jasur doim bunchalik **charchagan bo'lmasdi**.

sentences.text: If people **knew** how much sugar is in fizzy drinks, they **wouldn't drink** so many.
sentences.translation: Gazli ichimliklarda qancha shakar borligini **bilishganida**, odamlar ularni bunchalik ko'p **ichmasdi**.

sentences.text: Our office **would feel** much nicer if it **had** a few plants and more natural light.
sentences.translation: Bir nechta o'simlik va ko'proq tabiiy yorug'lik **bo'lganida**, ofisimiz ancha yoqimli **bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: What **would** you **say** to the president if you **met** him in the street?
sentences.translation: Prezidentni ko'chada **uchratib qolsangiz**, unga nima **derdingiz**?

sentences.text: Madina **would answer** the phone if she **heard** it, so she's probably in the shower.
sentences.translation: Madina telefonni **eshitganida**, **javob berardi**, demak u, ehtimol, dushda.

examples.title: **I wish** + past: wanting things to be different
examples.description: wish + Past Simple — hozirgi holatdan afsus yoki norozilik. O'zbekchada «qani endi ...sa». Haqiqat — teskarisi.

sentences.text: I **wish** I **knew** more about computers — I can't even fix my own laptop.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** kompyuterlar haqida ko'proq **bilsam** — o'z noutbukimni ham tuzata olmayman.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wishes** she **had** a bigger kitchen, because she loves cooking for friends.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **qani endi** oshxonam kattaroq **bo'lsa**, deydi, chunki do'stlariga ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: We **wish** we **lived** in the country, away from the noise and traffic.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** shovqin va tirbandlikdan uzoqda, qishloqda **yashasak**.

sentences.text: Sometimes I **wish** I **was** taller — I can never reach the top shelf.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan **qani endi** bo'yim balandroq **bo'lsa**, deyman — eng yuqori tokchaga hech qo'lim yetmaydi.

sentences.text: Tom **wishes** he **spoke** Russian, because his girlfriend's family doesn't speak English.
sentences.translation: Tom **qani endi** ruscha **gapira olsam**, deydi, chunki qiz do'stining oilasi inglizcha gapirmaydi.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** you **had** more free time to read?
sentences.translation: Kitob o'qishga ko'proq bo'sh **vaqtingiz bo'lishini** xohlamaysizmi?

sentences.text: I really **wish** my parents **understood** why I want to study abroad.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** ota-onam nega chet elda o'qimoqchi ekanimni **tushunishsa**.

sentences.text: How I **wish** I **had** your patience with small children!
sentences.translation: Kichkina bolalarga nisbatan sizdagi sabr **qani endi menda ham bo'lsa**!

sentences.text: Every Monday morning Kate **wishes** it **was** still the weekend.
sentences.translation: Har dushanba ertalab Keyt **qani endi** hali dam olish kuni **bo'lsa**, deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: My grandfather often says he **wishes** he **knew** how to use a smartphone.
sentences.translation: Bobom tez-tez **qani endi** smartfondan foydalanishni **bilsam**, deydi.

examples.title: **I wish** + negative: I wish it **wasn't** ...
examples.description: Haqiqat ijobiy bo'lsa, wish gapi inkorda: I wish I didn't have to ..., I wish it wasn't ..., I wish there weren't ...

sentences.text: I **wish** I **didn't have to** work this weekend — all my friends are going to the lake.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** bu dam olish kunlari **ishlashim shart bo'lmasa** — hamma do'stlarim ko'lga ketyapti.

sentences.text: Bekzod **wishes** his flat **wasn't** so far from the city centre.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **qani endi** kvartiram shahar markazidan bunchalik **uzoq bo'lmasa**, deydi.

sentences.text: We all **wish** the summers in Tashkent **weren't** so hot.
sentences.translation: Hammamiz **qani endi** Toshkentda yoz bunchalik **issiq bo'lmasa**, deymiz.

sentences.text: Sometimes Madina **wishes** she **didn't** have such a big family to cook for.
sentences.translation: Madina ba'zan **qani endi** ovqat pishiradigan oilam bunchalik **katta bo'lmasa**, deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: It's so noisy here. I **wish** the neighbours **didn't** play music every night.
sentences.translation: Bu yer juda shovqinli. **Qani endi** qo'shnilar har kecha musiqa **qo'ymasa**.

sentences.text: Oliver **wishes** he **wasn't** so shy at parties.
sentences.translation: Oliver **qani endi** bazmlarda bunchalik **uyatchan bo'lmasam**, deydi.

sentences.text: Don't you sometimes **wish** your phone **didn't** ring so often?
sentences.translation: Ba'zan telefoningiz bunchalik tez-tez **jiringlamasligini** xohlamaysizmi?

sentences.text: My sister **wishes** her job **wasn't** so stressful — she hardly sleeps.
sentences.translation: Opam **qani endi** ishim bunchalik **stressli bo'lmasa**, deydi — u deyarli uxlamaydi.

sentences.text: Honestly, I **wish** there **weren't** so many meetings — we never have time for real work.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, **qani endi** yig'ilishlar bunchalik **ko'p bo'lmasa** — haqiqiy ish uchun hech vaqtimiz qolmaydi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **wishes** she **didn't** need glasses, so she's saving for laser surgery.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **qani endi** ko'zoynak **kerak bo'lmasa**, deydi, shuning uchun lazer operatsiyasi uchun pul yig'yapti.

examples.title: **were**: **If I were** you ..., I wish it **were** ...
examples.description: if va wish dan keyin be — barcha shaxslarda were (og'zaki nutqda was ham). If I were you — maslahat qolipi.

sentences.text: If I **were** you, I**'d take** the job in Samarkand — the salary is much better.
sentences.translation: **Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam**, Samarqanddagi ishni **olardim** — maoshi ancha yaxshi.

sentences.text: I **wouldn't** worry so much if I **were** in your position.
sentences.translation: **Sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda**, bunchalik **xavotirlanmasdim**.

sentences.text: If it **were** up to me, the school day **would** start at ten.
sentences.translation: **Menga qolsa**, maktab kuni soat o'nda **boshlanardi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wishes** her mother **were** here to see her graduation.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **qani endi** onam shu yerda **bo'lsa**-yu, bitiruvimni ko'rsa, deydi.

sentences.text: If Tom **were** a bit more organised, he **wouldn't** lose his keys every week.
sentences.translation: Tom biroz tartibliroq **bo'lganida**, har hafta kalitlarini **yo'qotmasdi**.

sentences.text: We **wish** the weather **were** a little warmer, but it's still a great holiday.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** havo biroz iliqroq **bo'lsa**, lekin baribir zo'r ta'til.

sentences.text: What **would** you **do** if you **were** the mayor of Tashkent for a day?
sentences.translation: Bir kunga Toshkent hokimi **bo'lganingizda**, nima **qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: Life **would be** so much simpler if everybody **were** as honest as you.
sentences.translation: Hamma siz kabi halol **bo'lganida**, hayot ancha oddiyroq **bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, if I **was** in charge here, things **would** be very different.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, bu yerda men **rahbar bo'lganimda**, hammasi butunlay boshqacha **bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: James **wishes** he **were** ten years younger so that he could play football again.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **qani endi** o'n yosh yoshroq **bo'lsam**-u, yana futbol o'ynay olsam, deydi.

examples.title: **could**: If I **could** ..., I wish I **could** ...
examples.description: Qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat haqida xayol: If ... could, I wish ... could. O'zbekchada «-a olganimda», «qani endi -a olsam».

sentences.text: I **wish** I **could** come to your wedding, but I'll be in London that week.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** to'yingizga **kela olsam**, lekin o'sha hafta Londonda bo'laman.

sentences.text: If I **could** live anywhere, I**'d choose** a small town by the sea.
sentences.translation: Istalgan joyda **yashay olganimda**, dengiz bo'yidagi kichik shaharchani **tanlardim**.

sentences.text: Aziz **wishes** he **could** play the piano like his sister.
sentences.translation: Aziz **qani endi** opamdek pianino **chala olsam**, deydi.

sentences.text: We **could** travel much more if we **didn't** have such a big mortgage.
sentences.translation: Ipoteka qarzimiz bunchalik katta **bo'lmaganida**, ancha ko'proq **sayohat qila olardik**.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** you **could** stop time sometimes?
sentences.translation: Ba'zan vaqtni **to'xtata olishni** xohlamaysizmi?

sentences.text: If Emma **could** speak Uzbek, she**'d understand** the jokes at the dinner table.
sentences.translation: Emma o'zbekcha **gapira olganida**, dasturxon atrofidagi hazillarni **tushunardi**.

sentences.text: My daughter **wishes** she **could** have a puppy, but our flat is too small.
sentences.translation: Qizim **qani endi** kuchukcha **boqa olsam**, deydi, lekin kvartiramiz juda kichkina.

sentences.text: Most students **would get** better marks if they **could** sleep more during exams.
sentences.translation: Imtihon davrida ko'proq **uxlay olishganida**, ko'pchilik talabalar yaxshiroq baho **olardi**.

sentences.text: If only I **could** remember where I put my passport!
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** pasportimni qayerga qo'yganimni **eslay olsam**!

sentences.text: Sarah can't drive, but she **wishes** she **could**, because the buses are so slow in her village.
sentences.translation: Sara mashina hayday olmaydi, lekin **qani endi hayday olsam**, deydi, chunki uning qishlog'ida avtobuslar juda sekin.

examples.title: Fact → wish: I **don't** know → I wish I **knew**
examples.description: Avval haqiqat (hozirgi zamon), keyin xayol (o'tgan zamon shakli bilan wish yoki if). Teskari munosabatni ko'rish uchun.

sentences.text: I don't have a car, but I **wish** I **had** one — the buses take ages.
sentences.translation: Mashinam yo'q, lekin **qani endi bo'lsa** — avtobuslarda juda ko'p vaqt ketadi.

sentences.text: Kate doesn't know the answer, but she **wishes** she **did**.
sentences.translation: Keyt javobni bilmaydi, lekin **qani endi bilsam**, deydi.

sentences.text: It's raining again — I **wish** it **wasn't**, because I wanted to go cycling.
sentences.translation: Yana yomg'ir yog'yapti — **qani endi yog'masa**, velosipedda sayr qilmoqchi edim.

sentences.text: My job is so boring. If it **was** more interesting, I **wouldn't be looking** for a new one.
sentences.translation: Ishim juda zerikarli. U qiziqroq **bo'lganida**, yangi ish **izlamasdim**.

sentences.text: We live on the ninth floor and there's no lift. If only there **was** one!
sentences.translation: Biz to'qqizinchi qavatda yashaymiz, lift esa yo'q. **Qani endi** lift **bo'lsa**!

sentences.text: Jasur is always late. His boss **wishes** he **was** more punctual.
sentences.translation: Jasur doim kechikadi. Boshlig'i **qani endi** u vaqtga rioya **qilsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Grandma can't hear very well, so she **wishes** we **spoke** louder at dinner.
sentences.translation: Buvim yaxshi eshitmaydi, shuning uchun dasturxon atrofida balandroq **gapirishimizni** istaydi.

sentences.text: The hotel room doesn't have a view, but it **would be** perfect if it **did**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonasidan manzara ko'rinmaydi, **ko'rinsa**, **mukammal bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Oliver isn't here today. If he **was**, he**'d know** how to fix this printer.
sentences.translation: Oliver bugun yo'q. U shu yerda **bo'lganida**, printerni qanday tuzatishni **bilardi**.

sentences.text: Bukhara is so far away. If it **was** closer, we**'d visit** our relatives there more often.
sentences.translation: Buxoro juda uzoq. Yaqinroq **bo'lganida**, u yerdagi qarindoshlarimiznikiga tez-tez **borardik**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a rainy holiday in Edinburgh
examples.description: Suhbat: yomg'irli Edinburgda ikki do'st — wish, if + Past, were va could aralash.

sentences.text: — Look at this rain! I **wish** we **were** on a beach somewhere warm.
sentences.translation: — Bu yomg'irni qara! **Qani endi** biror iliq joyda, dengiz sohilida **bo'lsak**.

sentences.text: — Me too. If it **wasn't** so wet, we **could** climb Arthur's Seat today.
sentences.translation: — Men ham. Bunchalik nam **bo'lmaganida**, bugun Artur tepaligiga **chiqa olardik**.

sentences.text: — If I **knew** a good museum nearby, I**'d suggest** going there.
sentences.translation: — Yaqin atrofda yaxshi muzeyni **bilganimda**, o'sha yerga borishni **taklif qilardim**.

sentences.text: — There's the National Museum. I **wish** I **had** my guidebook with me, though.
sentences.translation: — Milliy muzey bor. Lekin **qani endi** yo'lko'rsatkich kitobim yonimda **bo'lsa**.

sentences.text: — Never mind, my phone has a map. If only the battery **wasn't** so low!
sentences.translation: — Mayli, telefonimda xarita bor. **Qani endi** quvvati bunchalik **kam bo'lmasa**!

sentences.text: — You know, if we **lived** here, we**'d** probably **get** used to the weather.
sentences.translation: — Bilasanmi, shu yerda **yashaganimizda**, ehtimol ob-havoga **ko'nikib ketardik**.

sentences.text: — Maybe, but I **wish** the sun **came** out at least once a day!
sentences.translation: — Balki, lekin **qani endi** quyosh kuniga hech bo'lmasa bir marta **chiqsa**!

sentences.text: — Ha! If you **were** Scottish, you**'d call** this a nice summer day.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! **Shotlandiyalik bo'lganingda**, buni yoqimli yoz kuni **derding**.

sentences.text: — Perhaps. Anyway, I **wish** I **could** find a warm café with good coffee.
sentences.translation: — Balki. Har holda, **qani endi** yaxshi qahvali iliq kafe **topa olsam**.

sentences.text: — There's one right behind you — if you **looked** around, you**'d see** it!
sentences.translation: — Orqangda bitta bor — atrofga **qaraganingda**, **ko'rarding**!

examples.title: Mixed: wishes and imagined situations
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: If + Past, I wish + Past, were, could — turli egalar va vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: I **wish** I **knew** what to buy for my mother's birthday — she has everything.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** onamning tug'ilgan kuniga nima olishni **bilsam** — unda hamma narsa bor.

sentences.text: If Aziz **were** here, he**'d know** the best restaurant in town.
sentences.translation: Aziz shu yerda **bo'lganida**, shahardagi eng yaxshi restoranni **bilardi**.

sentences.text: Many teenagers **wish** their parents **trusted** them more.
sentences.translation: Ko'p o'smirlar ota-onalari ularga ko'proq **ishonishini** istaydi.

sentences.text: The meeting **would finish** much faster if people **didn't** keep repeating themselves.
sentences.translation: Odamlar bir gapni qayta-qayta **takrorlamaganida**, yig'ilish ancha tez **tugardi**.

sentences.text: If I **had** a garden, I**'d grow** my own tomatoes and herbs.
sentences.translation: Bog'im **bo'lganida**, o'zim pomidor va ko'katlar **yetishtirardim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **wishes** she **could** work from home, but her company won't allow it.
sentences.translation: Sara **qani endi** uydan **ishlay olsam**, deydi, lekin kompaniyasi bunga ruxsat bermaydi.

sentences.text: We**'d go** to the mountains this weekend if the car **wasn't** at the garage.
sentences.translation: Mashina ustaxonada **bo'lmaganida**, bu dam olish kuni tog'larga **borardik**.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** life **was** as simple as when we were children?
sentences.translation: Hayot bolaligimizdagidek oddiy **bo'lishini** istamaysizmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod **wouldn't be** so stressed if he **said** no to extra work more often.
sentences.translation: Qo'shimcha ishlarga tez-tez **yo'q deganida**, Bekzod bunchalik **asabiylashmasdi**.

sentences.text: Your English is excellent — I **wish** mine **was** as good as yours!
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz a'lo — **qani endi** meniki ham sizniki kabi yaxshi **bo'lsa**!
